title: Journal and session sub-states mistaken for surfaces
why: A date pager, a filter pill row, a «CRM недоступна» panel, an error-with-retry and a «Нет данных» placeholder were counted as five surfaces. Under the widget contract a state is not a surface — an empty result and a refusal are the owning widget rendering itself, not something standing beside it — so all five belong inside the widget that owns them. Re-parenting is the right call. But three of the five carry behaviour that only looks like rendering. The staff pill row depends on a `GET /staff` fetch that nothing inside the journal itself triggers: it is fired by cabinet tab entry (L11483–11484 and the calendar and team branches of L13985) and by the team error-state retry (L14134) — every one of those call sites is a tab the merge retires, so after the merge nothing calls it. The two error states are told apart only by `_code`, and only one of them may ever offer «Повторить». The sessions placeholder belongs to a security screen (`roleMode: any`, not owner-only) and doubles as that screen's failure rendering. Re-parenting without carrying that behaviour across is a silent regression. The merge target itself is still unnamed on four of the five rows.
disappear: Five inventory rows — all `pwa`, all class `MERGE`, package K5/K8, and all `primaryNav: false`, so none of them is one of MAYA's 101 primary-nav entries; they are sub-states beneath them. No user-visible capability is lost **provided** the successor widget carries the `GET /staff` fetch that fills the pill row and composes the toolbar in the CRM-unavailable branch — today that branch returns before the toolbar is built (L14178 precedes L14206), so a naive merge carries the dead end forward, together with copy that points the owner at «раздел интеграций» while rendering no link to it (L14175–14177). Four successor cells and one canonical-owner cell are still `REQUIRES SIGNATURE`. Until they are filled, what these five fold into is not fixed on paper — and K16 does not permit a retirement whose successor is unnamed.
remain: ±7-day paging, the «Сегодня» reset to local midnight, the range label, the all-staff pill row with its `&providerId` refinement, and the two terminal codes `internal_calendar_disabled` / `crm_journal_not_supported` as refusal reasons that must NOT offer «Повторить». The `myJournalBusy` disable on all three nav buttons and the `myJournalReqRef` in-flight guard are requirements of the merged widget, not decoration. No new date granularity arrives with the merge: ±7 days and «Сегодня» are the whole of journal navigation (CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no date picker in the journal, no month or day granularity), so a chat-first «покажи октябрь» has no backing control until the fetch takes a real date range. For sessions: the error banner and the «Выйти на всех устройствах» control, which is gated on `sess.length > 1` and therefore vanishes whenever the load fails. The clean loading / loaded-empty / failed distinction is not something that survives the merge — it does not exist today; the merged widget has to introduce it.
risk: MEDIUM — the previous "LOW, the only risk is bookkeeping" is contradicted by three of its own rows, each of which fails silently and shows nothing to the user. If the successor does not carry `GET /staff`, per-master filtering simply never appears. If the two error states are flattened, «Повторить» starts being offered for `internal_calendar_disabled` / `crm_journal_not_supported`, which can never succeed and loops against a disabled integration. And on a failed sessions load the user today sees an error banner and «Нет данных» at once while the revoke-all control disappears. Not higher: nothing here moves server-side authority, no record or personal data is at stake, and the sessions failure still raises a banner, so it is not a false all-clear. But the safety net is thinner than it looks. K16 blocks any deletion without a named successor and a parity test naming it, which is why the four unsigned cells are blocking; parity measured against today's behaviour, however, would certify the CRM-unavailable dead end rather than catch it, and the generic parity requirement carried on these rows ("covers both behaviours") does not by itself test the retry discrimination. Each row's own risk note has to become its own check.
user_impact: Management roles, not the owner alone, for the four journal rows: the Календарь tab is pushed only when saasIsCalManager() is true — tenant_admin / tenant_owner / business_owner / administrator / manager (app.html L12431-12434, gate at L14020) — so the inventory's roleMode "owner" is a coarse label, not a fact about who sees it. S-577 is roleMode "any", so staff see the sessions state too. Today those roles move a fixed 7-day window with ‹ / › / «Сегодня» and filter by master with a pill row; after the change the same two controls ride on the calendar widget and can also be driven by an utterance. But there are three differences a user would actually see, not one. (1) The CRM-unavailable branch stops being a dead end: today it returns at L14226 before the toolbar is composed at L14254, stranding the user with no paging, no filter, no retry and no link to the «раздел интеграций» its own copy names (L14225), and merging onto S-545's shape restores the toolbar. S-545's «Повторить» is only "working" for the generic case, though — the merge must keep the _code branch alive, or retry is offered for internal_calendar_disabled / crm_journal_not_supported, which can never succeed. (2) The staff filter can silently disappear rather than ride along: it renders only when myStaff is a non-empty array (L14242), and loadMyStaff() is fired only from the two cabinet entry points G04 retires — the tab tap (L14029) and __meOpenSaasCabinet (L11505). Unless the merged widget owns that fetch, per-master filtering is lost with no error shown. (3) Chat-first raises a date expectation the fetch cannot meet. It is true that no month or day picker exists today (shiftJournal steps ±7 and nothing else), but the utterance channel invites «покажи октябрь» / «что было во вторник» while loadMyJournal builds a fixed from/to+7 window (L12619-12621); without a real date-range parameter that is a new user-visible failure, not neutrality. (Line numbers here follow the working copy the proposal cites, 42453 lines; the dossier's own S-id notes are numbered against the 41654-line evidence copy — same code, ~48 lines apart.)
security_impact: No change to consent records or tenant isolation: both journal endpoints are @TenantScoped() and read user.tenantId (internal-calendar.controller.ts L54-79; crm.service.ts L3165), the staff pill only appends &providerId (app.html L12622), and internal_calendar_disabled / crm_journal_not_supported are refusal renderings. Two corrections. (1) The S-577 improvement is real but its mechanism is misstated and its severity inflated: the catch does not only set mySessions=[] (L12816), it also sets mySessErr (L12817), which renders as «Не удалось загрузить устройства» directly above the list (L14550-14552). A failed load therefore does not read as a silent "no other devices signed in" — it renders a contradictory pair, a visible error plus «Нет данных». The actual defect is that the state is stuck: once mySessions is [] rather than null, the «Показать активные сессии» retry (L14552-14555) is gone and both callers of loadMySessions guard on === null (L11507, L14029), so neither per-session revoke nor the bulk action (gated at L14559) is reachable again without reloading the app. The three-state split fixes that; it does not close a false all-clear, because none exists. (2) "No client-side check that was load-bearing is removed" gets the direction wrong. saasIsCalManager() (L14020) is today the only thing keeping the journal and its per-master pill off a provider/employee/staff screen, and the CRM read path this widget takes for external-CRM tenants (L12623-12624) is gated by CRM_JOURNAL_ROLES, which deliberately includes PROVIDER, EMPLOYEE and STAFF (crm-integration.controller.ts L52-62), while getJournal passes query.providerId straight to the adapter with no per-actor fence (crm.service.ts L3212) — the write path has assertJournalStaffWritable, the read path has no counterpart. The API already admits a shift master reading a colleague's book, so this is not a new privilege; but re-parenting the widget to a chat-reachable capability converts a latent API permission into a one-utterance control, through exactly the pill row S-543 describes. G05 should therefore carry the condition G06 carries: no re-parenting ahead of a server-side authority gate on the journal read. The internal-calendar path is unaffected (INTERNAL_CALENDAR_MANAGER_ROLES excludes staff roles). Neither claim contradicts a frozen limitation — and the fail-closed posture is why this matters: the server-side authority gate is NORMATIVE-PENDING, so the client test is currently the only one holding.
